XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadic malfunctions of the Wi-Fi hotspot

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Vehicles equipped with special 6WD equipment (Personal Hotspot)

  • System: Electronics

  • Device: Telematics control unit (ATM-2)

  • Fault: Although the connection to the hotspot is active, websites fail to load sporadically

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Software error in the telematic control unit (ATM-2)

• Action: Reprogram the telematic control unit (ATM-2)

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: CAUTION : Using a diagnostic tool, verify that all related systems are functioning correctly. If there are any DTCs or symptomatic conditions other than those listed, resolve them before proceeding with this bulletin.
